notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Architects!

We are happy to announce that our game is live and playable!

Features available to you now:
- Fully playable game with 3 chapters

Features we plan to add during the EA:
- More chapters
- Updated dialogues

Our core point of EA is to gather your feedback of any kind. Found a bug - let us know, love the game - share it with us, got fresh and interesting ideas - we are here to listen to them!

Anyway, adventure can't wait, so hurry up and have fun playing!
